depiction.primary_object: digits 1, 2, 3 stacked beside three horizontal bars
depiction.composition: vertical column of three numbered lines, flat front view

readings.meaning: ranking, top choices, or priority order

ambiguity: At very small sizes the digits 1, 2, 3 can blur into square bullets, making it look like an ordinary bulleted list or hamburger menu.
task_intents: rank candidates or options in order
outline chapters or sections in sequence

near_misses.better: three-line menu icon or browser window

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a numbered list (1, 2, 3 with horizontal lines). While originating as a text-formatting glyph, in a to-do app it serves well for tasks centered on ranking options, setting priorities, writing step-by-step instructions, or preparing ordered agendas, though at tiny sizes the numbers can blur into a generic bulleted list.
